samples.tryASampleText: Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants use sunlight to turn water and carbon dioxide into glucose and oxygen. It takes place mainly in the leaves, inside structures called chloroplasts.
samples.biologyNotesText: Cells are the basic building blocks of all living things. Every cell contains a nucleus that holds genetic material, a cell membrane that controls what enters and leaves, and mitochondria that produce energy for the cell to function.
samples.historyParagraphText: The Silk Road was an ancient network of trade routes that connected the East and West, stretching from China to the Mediterranean Sea. For centuries, merchants carried silk, spices, and ideas along these paths, shaping cultures across Asia and Europe.
